відповідь.body: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"version\":\"1\",\"text\":\"This is a New Year party in a restaurant, so I built the evening around the brown suit: the fitted strapless top and the wide-leg trousers read as dressed-up without effort. The coat takes you through the frost on the way there. The ankle boots and the bag keep the finish simple, and the earrings add the small festive spark. The top fits closely at the waist and the trousers fall in one long straight line, so the waist stays the one place where your body shows and the line stays calm and tall. Because the coat is roomy, I keep it open so it adds no second wide line next to the trousers. The look is a touch more relaxed than a formal party, which is why the shine of the earrings matters here.\",\"how_to_wear\":[\"Wear the coat open over the suit, so the waist of the strapless top stays visible and the line stays long.\",\"Let the hems of the suit trousers fall straight over the ankle boots, so the ankle boots finish the line cleanly.\",\"Keep the earrings as your only sparkle, so they carry the festive note against the plain brown of the suit.\"],\"named\":[{\"n\":\"#256·05\",\"what\":\"brown suit with strapless top and wide-leg trousers\"},{\"n\":\"#88·43\",\"what\":\"grey coat\"},{\"n\":\"#537·03\",\"what\":\"ankle boots\"},{\"n\":\"#73·03\",\"what\":\"bag\"},{\"n\":\"#158·36\",\"what\":\"earrings\"}],\"about_items\":[{\"n\":\"#256·05\",\"text\":\"A matching top and trousers make you look put together for a restaurant party in one step. The fitted top marks your waist and the wide trousers give a long, uninterrupted line.\"},{\"n\":\"#88·43\",\"text\":\"It gets you to the restaurant on a frosty evening and, worn open, keeps a clean vertical line down the front. Its calm grey lets the suit stay the centre of the evening.\"},{\"n\":\"#537·03\",\"text\":\"The ankle boots close the outfit at the ankle and keep the trouser line tidy. They are a practical, grounded finish for a winter evening out.\"},{\"n\":\"#73·03\",\"text\":\"The bag holds what you need for the evening so your hands stay free at the table. It keeps the outfit simple and finished.\"},{\"n\":\"#158·36\",\"text\":\"The earrings bring the festive touch the New Year party asks for. They lift the plain suit toward an evening out, right by your face.\"}]}"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":21152,"output_tokens":1512},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
